purpose: Master taxonomy for the CFNM.si Adult Web Trends Observatory. Terms are research labels, not endorsements or rankings.

categories.name: General adult web
categories.description: Broad, non-graphic terminology used to study the adult-web ecosystem.

categories.name: Adult video terminology
categories.description: High-level search language describing adult video formats and platforms.

categories.name: Creator economy
categories.description: Terms connected with independent adult creators and subscription-based publishing.

categories.name: Live and webcam
categories.description: General terminology for live adult-web services without storing or displaying explicit material.

categories.name: Fetish terminology
categories.description: Acronyms and high-level terminology used to study niche adult search language.

categories.name: LGBTQ+ adult terminology
categories.description: Broad terminology for studying adult-web search language across LGBTQ+ categories.

categories.name: Adult animation and anime
categories.description: Broad terminology for adult animation and anime-related search behavior.

categories.name: Adult dating and relationships
categories.description: Search language around adult dating, relationships and adult-oriented social platforms.

categories.name: Privacy and safety
categories.description: Research terms for privacy, security, age boundaries and account protection on adult websites.

categories.name: Industry and business
categories.description: Commercial and professional terminology used to study the adult-web economy.

categories.name: Search behavior and terminology
categories.description: Research concepts used to interpret search demand and terminology changes.

country_scope.expansion: Use all countries and subregions supported by the selected source when available.

measurement_rules.google_trends_interest: Relative index, normally scaled 0-100 within the selected query, geography and time context.
measurement_rules.absolute_search_volume: Never derive an absolute count from a Google Trends normalized score.
measurement_rules.search_volume: Only display an absolute volume when a source explicitly provides one and the source/method is recorded.
measurement_rules.demographics: Do not infer gender, sexuality, age or identity from Google Trends search data.
measurement_rules.low_volume: Treat missing or zero Trends values as insufficient public signal, not proof of zero searches.
measurement_rules.comparisons: Keep geography, time range and search property consistent when comparing terms.
measurement_rules.adult_content: Store terminology and aggregate research signals only; do not store explicit media or scraped adult-site content.

source_strategy.google_trends_explore: Specific keyword/topic interest, geography, related searches and rising searches.
source_strategy.google_trends_bigquery: Public Top 25 and Top 25 Rising discovery layer for supported countries/regions.
source_strategy.trending_now: Recent trend discovery and trend-breakdown layer where supported.
source_strategy.other_public_sources: Add only when provenance, methodology and licensing/terms permit reuse.

limits.absolute_search_volume: not derived from normalized Trends scores
limits.content_policy: No explicit media, scraped adult libraries, downloads, or personal search data.
